name: 24514-batchdecode-30ba3b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B, bf16, ungated. NOT in the local HF cache: ~57 GB downloads before the first run.
parallelism: Eight ranks of one node: tp8, dp8, attention data-parallel on, ep8, pp1. Attention is replicated per rank (each holds all 4 KV heads, 96 KiB of KV per token); the 128 experts of every layer are sharded across the eight, ~7.3 GB of expert weight and ~3 GB of attention and dense weight per rank.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256 -- 32 per data-parallel rank. Warmup the first 25%, bounded at 3072 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix and no shared structure: ~512 prompt tokens in (stdev 64, clamped 384-640) and ~1024 tokens out (stdev 128, clamped 768-1280). temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request generates exactly the number of tokens its draw asked for.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, serving 256 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`; the interpreter is
# named by configs/env.yaml `venv:`.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
ep-size: 8

enable-return-routed-experts: true

# Pinned rather than left to the memory probe: a probed pool on this node is machine-
# dependent and large enough that the server does not start. Do not remove this key.
max-total-tokens: 131072

# Prompts share no prefix, so the tree can only add bookkeeping and never return a hit.
disable-radix-cache: true
